title: Shalok, Third Mehla:
summary: Attachment is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
lifeApplication: Practice holding the gift without claiming authorship over it. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.

source.lifeApplication: Attachment becomes more truthful when shalok, Third Mehla:.

evidence.turn: Attachment steadies when they lose their lives uselessly; they die, only to be re-born, over and over.
